description: This describes the metric being measured such as number of casualties, number injured, and number of houses destroyed, or number of acres burned.

description: This entity provides a list of possible severity codes for each causal event type being used.  Example: - Hurricane = class 1 through 5

name: CAUSAL_EVENT_SUBTYPE
description: This is a subtype discriminator for causal events as either man-made or natural.

name: CAUSAL_EVENT_TYPE
description: This is a code for the type of causal event such as weather, war, stock market crash, or terrorist attack. In this context, a causal event is an external event that has an impact to the operation of the enterprise.

name: CHECK_EVENT

description: This entity identifies the role that an event can play with the claim authorization, for example, "is the causing event." name: CLAIM_EVENT
description: This entity contains those events that are related to claims. Although many events will be related to only one claim, some events may be related to multiple claims. description: This entity captures information specific to system defined custom events. These are events configured by the web site to capture information unique to specific visitor event types.

name: CUSTOM_PAGE_VIEW_EVENT

name: EVENT

description: This is a code for the value for a given scheme. This entity also allows you to create a hierarchy of values where one is at a higher level than another.

name: EVENT_CONTENT
description: This entity identifies the type of medium that was passed from the customer to the financial institution and back from the financial institution to the customer.

description: This entity identifies the cash denomination for a given event and medium. description: This entity identifies costs at the activity level. An activity may have more than one cost associated with it. These are fully burdened costs that are used to calculate profitability.

name: EVENT_DOCUMENT
description: This entity identifies the documents involved in an event such as a check, a claim submittal form, a deposit slip, and an application form.

description: This entity contains the role that the document has in the event such as the document is attached to this event or the document is the subject of this event.

description: This entity relates a classification value for a given classification scheme to the event that is being classified.  For a given classification scheme an event can have only one value at one point-in-time.

name: EVENT_FORECAST_METRIC
description: This entity contains forecasted metrics about an event. For example, if the event is a weather alert or a major incident then the forecast would be amount of rainfall, wind speed, barometric pressure, and snowfall amount.

name: EVENT_GROUP
description: This entity identifies a group of events that have some meaning for the financial institution such as session, transaction, or issue. All these are ways of grouping events together for different purposes.

name: EVENT_GROUP_TYPE
description: This minor entity defines the different ways that events can be grouped together. Events can be grouped into transactions, sessions, and issues.

name: EVENT_GROUP_XREF
description: This associative entity relates an event to groups of events. An event can be a part of many groups, and a group consists of many events.

name: EVENT_MEDIUM_TYPE
description: A code for the type of medium involved in the exchange such as base currency cash, nonbase currency cash, check, money order, and electronic.

name: EVENT_METRIC

name: EVENT_STATUS
description: A history of the status of this event over time.  Examples: - A credit card charge request event may be pending approval, approved, rejected, and accepted.

description: This minor entity describes the event status such as completed, not completed, pending, in progress, suspended, canceled, abandoned, and refused.

name: EVENT_SUBTYPE
description: This is the discriminator that identifies the subtype of EVENT. For example, an event many be an agreement event, or an agreement group event, or an application event, or a quotation event, or a causal event. An event may also be none of these types.

name: EVENT_TEXT
description: This entity contains textual messages associated with this event. These can include bank-to-bank instructions, person-to-person instructions, and call center notes. name: LEGAL_ACTION_EVENT
